title: Landfill leachate treatment by the symbiotic system of bacteria and microalgae: high-efficiency and low-consumption green biological treatment system
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17627-17647
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02058E, Paper

This study proposed a critical threshold theory for bacterial-algae symbiosis, providing a design basis for photobioreactor construction. New insights into highly effective, low-consumption green biological treatment of landfill leachate.
